name: evidence_jsonl_validate
argv:
import json
from pathlib import Path
p = Path('Document/Update/Alpha/v4.1.0/evidence/WP01/commands.jsonl')
records = [json.loads(line) for line in p.read_text(encoding='utf-8').splitlines() if line.strip()]
for r in records:
    assert {'name','argv','cwd','exit_code','stdout_path'} <= set(r), r['name']
    assert isinstance(r['argv'], list) and isinstance(r['exit_code'], int) and r['stdout_path'] == ''
print('records', len(records), 'ok', [r['exit_code'] for r in records])
notes: self-check of the 8 records written before this one; run1's exit code 1 is the retained failing run
